comparison.objective: Clear objects from a laptop and open its stiff lid without spill, tip, or damage.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe multi-object relocation followed by bimanual hold-down and lid lifting.
comparison.success_condition: Objects safely set aside, laptop base stable, and lid opened at least 90 degrees.
comparison.reason: Obstacle clearing and stabilized hinge opening do not test guided transfer between rail sections or rolling-element containment.
